title: termal_get_session_result: a non-parent reader gets 409 'retained review result identity does not match a confirmed publication' for a resubmitted (attempt 2) Codex result the parent reads as published and validated
outcome: An authorized non-parent reader that supplies the exact delegation id, submission attempt and result id of a published, validated result reads the same immutable result the parent reads, or gets a refusal naming the real reason (for example that it is not authorized), never a misleading identity-mismatch 409.
acceptance: For a delegation whose result was resubmitted (submissionAttempt 2) and is published and validated, an authorized non-parent reader passing the exact delegationId, submissionAttempt and resultId gets the same result (disposition, submission state, message id and complete output) as the parent; if the reader is not authorized, the refusal says so instead of reporting an identity mismatch.
A test covers parent and non-parent exact reads of a second-attempt result, plus a first-attempt control, and asserts identical results or the correct authorization refusal.
